title: Causado con 에게/을를
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide’s **-게 하다** section documents target arguments marked with **이/가**, **을/를**, or **에게/한테** in its examples. This entry is restricted to the attested alternation; the source does not support a universal rule predicting a marker without regard to predicate and context.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 377–378 (printed pp. 365–366): case-marking examples “엄마가 아이가/아이를 …” and “엄마가 아이에게/아이한테 …”.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona directamente con **-게 하다**, con las partículas **에게/한테** y **을/를**, y con otras construcciones causativas en las que cambia la manera de marcar al participante causado.
